items.title: Dave S. Oxley Sr. Interview, 1965-01-06
items.q: >> [INTERVIEWEE] That's right. That's a funny thing, Mr. Bill.

ctx.x: Well, I heard her that same year, I guess, maybe in the spring of the year before she died, up at the Apollo. She'd be there a couple times a year and once at the Harlem Opera House.
That's right. That's a funny thing, Mr. Bill.
